pairs: Congregatique sunt omnes filii Israël in Silo,
And all the sons of Israel gathered together at Shiloh,
ibique fixerunt tabernaculum testimonii,
and there they stationed the Tabernacle of the Testimony.
et fuit eis terra subjecta.
And the land was subjected to them.
Remanserant autem filiorum Israël septem tribus, quæ necdum acceperant possessiones suas.
But there remained seven tribes of the sons of Israel which had not yet received their possessions.
Ad quos Josue ait:
And Joshua said to them:
Usquequo marcetis ignavia, et non intratis ad possidendam terram,
“For how long will you draw back in idleness, and not enter to possess the land,
quam Dominus Deus patrum vestrorum dedit vobis?
which the Lord, the God of your fathers, has given to you?
Eligite de singulis tribubus ternos viros,
Select three men from each tribe,
ut mittam eos,
so that I may send them,
et pergant atque circumeant terram,
and they may go forth and circle through the land,
et describant eam juxta numerum uniuscujusque multitudinis:
and may describe it according to the number of each multitude,
referantque ad me quod descripserint.
and may bring back to me what they have written down.
Dividite vobis terram in septem partes:
Divide the land for yourselves into seven parts.
Judas sit in terminis suis ab australi plaga,
Let Judah be its bounds on the southern side,
et domus Joseph ab aquilone.
and the house of Joseph to the north.
Mediam inter hos terram in septem partes describite:
The land that is in the middle, between these, write it down in seven parts.
et huc venietis ad me,
And you shall come to me,
ut coram Domino Deo vestro mittam vobis hic sortem:
so that I may cast lots for you about this, before the Lord your God.
quia non est inter vos pars Levitarum,
But there is no portion among you for the Levites.
sed sacerdotium Domini est eorum hæreditas.
Instead, the priesthood of the Lord is their inheritance.
Gad autem et Ruben,
And Gad and Reuben,
et dimidia tribus Manasse,
and the one half tribe of Manasseh,
jam acceperant possessiones suas trans Jordanem ad orientalem plagam,
have already received their possessions beyond the Jordan in the eastern region,
quas dedit eis Moyses famulus Domini.
which Moses, the servant of the Lord, gave to them.”
Cumque surrexissent viri,
And when the men had risen up,
ut pergerent ad describendam terram,
so that they might go out to describe the land,
præcepit eis Josue,
Joshua instructed them,
dicens:
saying,
Circuite terram,
“Circle through the land,
et describite eam,
and describe it,
ac revertimini ad me:
and return to me,
ut hic coram Domino,
so that I may cast lots for you about this,
in Silo,
before the Lord,
mittam vobis sortem.
in Shiloh.”
Itaque perrexerunt:
And so they went out.
et lustrantes eam,
And surveying it,
in septem partes diviserunt,
they divided it into seven parts,
scribentes in volumine.
writing it in a book.
Reversique sunt ad Josue in castra Silo.
And they returned to Joshua, to the camp at Shiloh.
Qui misit sortes coram Domino in Silo,
And he cast lots before the Lord, at Shiloh,
divisitque terram filiis Israël in septem partes.
and he divided the land to the sons of Israel, in seven parts.
Et ascendit sors prima filiorum Benjamin per familias suas,
And the first lot went to the sons of Benjamin,
ut possiderent terram inter filios Juda
by their families,
et filios Joseph.
so that they would possess the land between the sons of Judah and the sons of Joseph.
Fuitque terminus eorum contra aquilonem a Jordane:
And their border toward the north was from the Jordan,
pergens juxta latus Jericho septentrionalis plagæ,
continuing on, near the side of Jericho in the northern region,
et inde contra occidentem ad montana conscendens et perveniens ad solitudinem Bethaven,
and from there, ascending toward the west to the mountains, and extending to the wilderness of Bethaven.
atque pertransiens juxta Luzam ad meridiem,
And it continues to the south beside Luz,
ipsa est Bethel:
which is Bethel.
descenditque in Ataroth Addar,
And it descends into Ataroth-addar,
in montem qui est ad meridiem Beth-horon inferioris:
at the mountain which is to the south of lower Beth-horon.
et inclinatur circuiens contra mare ad meridiem montis qui respicit Beth-horon contra Africum:
And it turns aside, circling toward the sea, to the south of the mountain which looks out toward Beth-horon,
suntque exitus ejus in Cariath-baal,
toward the southwest. And its exits are toward Kiriath-baal,
quæ vocatur et Cariathiarim,
which is also called Kiriath-jearim,
urbem filiorum Juda.
a city of the sons of Judah.
Hæc est plaga contra mare,
This is their region, toward the sea,
ad occidentem.
in the west.
A meridie autem ex parte Cariathiarim egreditur terminus contra mare,
But to the south, the border goes on from the part of Kiriath-jearim toward the sea,
et pervenit usque ad fontem aquarum Nephtoa.
and it continues as far as the Fountain of the waters of Nephtoah.
Descenditque in partem montis, qui respicit vallem filiorum Ennom:
And it descends to that part of the mountain which looks out toward the Valley of the sons of Hinnom.
et est contra septentrionalem plagam in extrema parte vallis Raphaim.
And it is opposite the northern region, in the furthest part of the Valley of the Rephaim.
Descenditque in Geennom (id est,
And it descends into Geennom, (that is,
vallem Ennom) juxta latus Jebusæi ad austrum:
the Valley of Hinnom,) near the side of the Jebusite toward the south.
et pervenit ad fontem Rogel,
And it extends to the Fountain of Rogel,
transiens ad aquilonem,
crossing from there to the north,
et egrediens ad Ensemes,
and going out to En-Shemesh,
id est,
that is,
fontem solis:
to the Fountain of the Sun.
et pertransit usque ad tumulos, qui sunt e regione ascensus Adommim:
And it passes through to the hills that are opposite the region of the Ascent of Adummim.
descenditque ad Abenboën,
And it descends to Abenboen,
id est,
that is,
lapidem Boën filii Ruben:
so the stone of Bohan, the son of Reuben.
et pertransit ex latere aquilonis ad campestria:
And it continues on, at the northern side, to the plains.
descenditque in planitiem,
And it descends into the flatlands.
et prætergreditur contra aquilonem Beth Hagla:
And it advances before Beth-hoglah, to the north.
suntque exitus ejus contra linguam maris salsissimi ab aquilone in fine Jordanis ad australem plagam:
And its exits are to the north, opposite the bay of the very salty sea, in the southern region at the end of the Jordan,
qui est terminus illius ab oriente.
which is its border to the east.
Hæc est possessio filiorum Benjamin per terminos suos in circuitu,
This is the possession of the sons of Benjamin, with their borders all around,
et familias suas.
and by their families.
Fueruntque civitates ejus,
And their cities were:
Jericho et Beth Hagla et vallis Casis,
Jericho and Beth-hoglah and the Abrupt Valley,
Beth Araba et Samaraim et Bethel
Beth-arabah and Zemaraim and Bethel,
et Avim et Aphara et Ophera,
and Avvim and Parah and Ophrah,
villa Emona
the town of Ammoni,
et Ophni
and Ophni,
et Gabee:
and Geba:
civitates duodecim,
twelve cities,
et villæ earum.
and their villages;
Gabaon et Rama et Beroth,
Gibeon and Ramah and Beeroth,
et Mesphe et Caphara, et Amosa
and Mizpeh and Chephirah and Mozah,
et Recem,
and Rekem,
Jarephel
Irpeel,
et Tharela,
and Taralah,
et Sela,
and Zela,
Eleph,
Haeleph,
et Jebus,
and Jebus,
quæ est Jerusalem,
which is Jerusalem,
Gabaath
Gibeah and Kiriath:
et Cariath:
fourteen cities,
civitates quatuordecim,
and their villages.
et villæ earum.
This is the possession of the sons of Benjamin,
Hæc est possessio filiorum Benjamin juxta familias suas.
according to their families.
